# 1_50

<span class="tada-chip tada-chip--muted">complete</span> <span class="tada-chip tada-chip--muted" title="Locked flights are released from the window; trained and scored in that environment">release MDP</span>

**What changed:** From scratch in the release MDP: locked flights released from the window (±30 s), bracket paid at release, flat deviation potential, feasible-only training by redraw at reset (≤ 650 s early), ±30 s bracket worth 4. Recipe arm D (10 flights to 2.5M, then 20 to 10M), LR 3e-4 to 3e-5, seed 1.

!!! note "Release MDP"
    This model trained in a different MDP from every earlier model, the champion included: after each step the front of the landing queue is released once a flight is locked (predicted within 30 s of its target and in no predicted conflict). A released flight leaves the window and can no longer be cleared. It is scored in the same environment, on the same seeds and with the same metrics, so its numbers measure landings in the same scenarios, but under that extra constraint on the agent.

## Reproduce

```bash
recipes/windowed_from_scratch.sh 1 D --hard-bracket --release-locked --pay-at-release --flat-deviation --train-max-early-s 650 --run-suffix scratch_d_release_s1

# score: 20-flight and stitched 2x20, 10 attempts, lookahead (100 validation seeds)
TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 TADA_MAX_PICKS=2 python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_50_scratch_d_release_s1/final_model.zip --seeds 100 --attempts 9
```
